label: Food-price-pressure forecast (LightGBM, Lead-2)
definition_in_firi_py: LightGBM Lead-2 probability that the food-price gap is high (p_price)
limitation: A model output, not an observation: it already combines CPI inputs, so it double-counts A2/A3 information and cannot be audited as data. Lead 2 did not meet the objectives (LEAD2 phases).

label: Headline inflation above the usual level
definition_in_firi_py: headline CPI YoY projection minus the province's frozen P60 (HEADLINE_P60)
limitation: Threshold frozen on 6 quarters of 2021-22; headline CPI includes food, so it overlaps A1.

label: Wholesale rice price change
limitation: One commodity; ignores retail, farmgate and other staples. Retail rice YoY correlates 0.70 with it.

label: Poverty and population density
definition_in_firi_py: 0.6 x poverty (SAE 2021, mean of LGUs) + 0.4 x density (POPCEN 2024), min-max over 5 provinces
limitation: Static; weights not derived from data; min-max over 5 provinces makes the lowest province 0 by construction; density is a weak food-insecurity proxy; subsistence and FIES food share unused.

label: PAGASA El Nino alert/advisory in force
definition_in_firi_py: PAGASA El Nino alert/advisory in force (0/1)
limitation: Binary national flag, identical for all provinces; ENSO showed about no effect (E65).

label: Typhoons within 300 km
limitation: 300 km covers the whole region: in 64% of quarters all five provinces have the same count; firi.py lists it as one value per origin.

label: Palay/corn production drop
definition_in_firi_py: minus the lower of palay and corn production YoY
limitation: Mixes a supply shock with harvest timing; vegetables and root crops not represented; release dates rule-based.

label: Fisheries production drop
limitation: Grouped with climate in the code (domain letter C) although it is a production measure; aquaculture is a part of it, not independent.

label: Unemployment change (national)
limitation: National only; provincial annual LFS (owner file) unused; underemployment not represented.

label: Remittance decline (national)
limitation: National, by source country not destination province; some quarters lack dated reports.

label: Food Stress Sentiment Index (FSSI-v3)
definition_in_firi_py: FSSI-v3 news index, needs >= 5 admitted articles
limitation: 56.5% missing in E119 (too few articles); no forecasting gain found (E64, E117).

label: Regional hunger outlook above 11.3%
geography_as_served: region (Balance Luzon), shown for every province
limitation: An outcome used as an input; the 11.3% line is the P60 of 6 quarters; regional value presented beside provincial ones.
